text: Hi! Hehe... you're new here, right?
Oh! Hi hi! I was waiting for you.
Hehe. Found you.
Stay close to me, okay? It's safer.
ko: 나한테 붙어 있어, 알았지? 그게 안전해.

text: Do you like it here? I do. Mostly.
Hehe, your footsteps are so loud.
I used to work in the mart. I think.
ko: 나 마트에서 일했던 것 같아. 아마.

text: Don't look at the big heads. They hate that. Hehe.
ko: 큰 머리들 쳐다보지 마. 그거 싫어해. 히히.

text: Have you seen the exit? Me neither. Hehe.
ko: 출구 봤어? 나도 못 봤어. 히히.

text: Wanna hear a secret? ...Never mind.
You're my favorite. Don't tell the others.
ko: 너가 제일 좋아. 다른 애들한텐 비밀.

text: Hey... hey. Are you listening to me?
ko: 야… 야. 내 말 듣고 있어?

text: This store never closes. Isn't that nice?
ko: 이 가게는 문을 안 닫아. 좋지 않아?

text: Shh. Did you hear the horn?
Hehehe!
Hihi.
Hehe... hehe.
Here! Take this. It's really bright.
For you! Don't lose it, okay?
Why are you leaving me?
Hey. Where are you going?
I'm... so tired...
